## THE FAILURE STORY

By February 2026, the team had pushed both `system_v5-consolidation` and `system_v7-bridge` worktrees to origin, each claiming HEAD at f0afdc36a (a shared commit from July 17 that unified CB library wiring). The two worktrees had diverged locally after that point — one added system_v5 schema fixes, the other rewired v7 imports — but both carried the same merge-base. When the release lead tried to fast-forward merge both branches into main in sequence, git accepted the first (no new commits to replay). The second merge appeared clean but actually contained dead code paths: the v7 bridge changes assumed the v5 fixes were already in scope, but git had no way to detect this cross-branch coupling. The merge commit landed. Three days later, in integration testing, the CB library loader failed silently on v5 schemas because the assumed v5 fix never actually executed — it was in the first worktree's diff, not in main's history.
